_comment: The plan's list of services, built from the DHCS notices BHIN 26-030 (outpatient SMHS), BHIN 22-017 (psychiatric inpatient and PHF) and BHIN 24-001 (DMC-ODS).
Rule: PriorAuthorization, ConcurrentReview or NoPriorAuthorization. Services not on the list need no prior authorization.
CodeConfirmed false: the code or modifier has not been confirmed against the current DHCS billing manual. The plan's billing staff must confirm each one.

Questionnaires with Status draft have not been signed off by the plan's clinical lead. Draft questions written from the DHCS notices. They must be reviewed and signed off by the plan's clinical lead before real use.

Left out on purpose: ASAM 3.7 and 4.0 (covering them is optional for DMC-ODS plans; add them once the plan confirms it covers them and the code), and STRTP (a facility type, not a service DHCS lists).

ServiceRequirements.Name: Acute psychiatric inpatient hospital services
ServiceRequirements.Note: Concurrent review, not prior authorization. No prior authorization for emergency care. Inpatient claims carry a revenue code; confirm which code admission notices will carry.

ServiceRequirements.Name: Psychiatric health facility (PHF)
ServiceRequirements.Note: Concurrent review, not prior authorization. Code taken from a 2015 notice; confirm against the current billing manual.

ServiceRequirements.Name: Crisis residential treatment services
ServiceRequirements.Source: BHIN 26-030 (referral or concurrent review only); MHSUDS IN 15-030 Enclosure 1 (2015)
ServiceRequirements.Note: MHPs may not require prior authorization. Code taken from a 2015 notice; confirm.

ServiceRequirements.Name: Adult residential treatment services
ServiceRequirements.Source: BHIN 26-030 (referral or concurrent review only); MHSUDS IN 15-030 Enclosure 1 (2015)
ServiceRequirements.Note: MHPs may not require prior authorization. Shares H0019 with the DMC-ODS residential levels, which are told apart by modifiers U1, U2 and U3; confirm the modifiers used for adult residential.
